top_stories.title: Donald Trump walks out of interview after being pressed for evidence of how Biden rigged the 2020 election: 'I’ve had enough' - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** abruptly ended a television interview with **NBC's Meet the Press** after a heated exchange with moderator **Kristen Welker**. The discussion centered on **Trump's** repeated claims of election rigging, particularly in California.  **Welker** challenged these allegations, stating there was no evidence to support them, prompting **Trump** to accuse her and other media outlets of dishonesty. **Trump** defended his "anti-weaponization fund" proposal, which has since stalled, before accusing the media of being "one-sided crooked networks." The interview concluded with **Trump** removing his microphone and walking away.

top_stories.title: Nagpur boys steal Rs 11-lakh luxury taps to buy iPhones for girlfriends | Trending News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Three boys** from Nagpur, India, were apprehended for stealing over Rs 11 lakh worth of luxury sanitary fittings from a warehouse owned by **Rahul Jaichand Brahma**. The incident occurred on May 27 and 28, with the boys allegedly entering the warehouse through a cut roof to steal premium agricultural and household taps. They admitted to the theft to purchase iPhones for their girlfriends, according to police.  The stolen items have been recovered, and the investigation is ongoing.

top_stories.title: ‘AI platform to connect Parliament, Assemblies’: Haryana Speaker Harvinder Kalyan | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Sukhbir Siwach**, a journalist, has extensively covered farmer agitation against three farm laws. **Om Birla**, the Lok Sabha Speaker, will inaugurate the North Zone Conference of the Commonwealth Parliamentary Association (CPA) in Chandigarh from June 8 to 10. The conference focuses on strengthening democratic institutions and addressing future challenges through collaboration among legislatures and an informed society.  The conference aims to connect Parliament and State Assemblies through a common AI-enabled digital platform, facilitating knowledge sharing and best practices across states. **Harvinder Kalyan**, the Haryana Assembly Speaker, highlights the importance of capacity building, research support, committee system improvement, and coordination between legislature and executive as priorities for the Haryana Legislative Assembly.

top_stories.title: PM congratulates Major Abhilasha Barak for receiving UN Military Gender Advocate of the Year Award | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** congratulated **Major Abhilasha Barak**, the first woman combat helicopter pilot in the **Indian Army**, on receiving the UN Military Gender Advocate of the Year Award.  The award recognizes Major Barak's outreach efforts and community engagement activities for women and adolescent girls, as well as her gender sensitization training for peacekeepers. She has been serving with the **United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL)** since June 2025 and is currently an Engagement Team Commander and Gender Focal Point within the mission.  The award follows previous recipients from India, Major Suman Gawani and Major Radhika Sen.

top_stories.title: Lawsuit seeks to stop Trump’s planned White House UFC match | Donald Trump News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: A lawsuit has been filed against **President Donald Trump** seeking to halt his planned UFC event at the White House on his 80th birthday. The plaintiffs, represented by lawyer Brendan Ballou, argue that the event violates US National Park Service regulations and lacked proper authorization. The **White House**, however, maintains that the event is a permitted gathering similar to other events held on federal grounds.  The lawsuit claims the event constitutes "private, commercial, corrupt use of our most sacred national monuments for private gain".

top_stories.title: From borderland to India’s strategic resource frontier - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Ministry of Mines** has recently begun framing **northeastern states** as repositories of strategic minerals and untapped potential.  Manipur, Arunachal Pradesh, Meghalaya, and Mizoram have been described as "quiet mineral frontiers" and "resource-rich frontiers," respectively. This shift in language reflects a broader trend of the northeast being increasingly framed in national conversations and strategic pictures.

top_stories.title: "Sachin Pilot Should Forgive, Forget": Ashok Gehlot Talks Of 2022 Stand-Off
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Ashok Gehlot** denied revolting against the **Congress** high command, stating that the rebellion of 100 MLAs was directed at **Sachin Pilot**.  He claimed that the September 25, 2022 incident was against Pilot who was being considered as the next Chief Minister. Sources suggest the party may replace **Govind Singh Dotasara** and reinstate **Sachin Pilot**, but no official confirmation has been made. The situation remains tense in Rajasthan with Gehlot expressing personal affection for Pilot while criticizing his political advisors.

top_stories.title: Italy recovers 10 bodies as boat with nearly 60 on board capsizes off Malta | Refugees News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Italian coastguard** recovered 10 bodies after a boat carrying nearly 60 refugees and migrants capsized near Malta.  Search operations are ongoing, coordinated by the Maltese authorities. This incident follows a series of boat wrecks in the Mediterranean this year, with at least 990 deaths recorded so far in 2023, according to the **United Nations’ International Organization for Migration (IOM)**. The IOM also reported that at least 2,180 people died or went missing last year.  The latest tragedy comes amidst discussions about new EU rules on deporting rejected asylum seekers.

top_stories.title: From borderland to India’s strategic resource frontier - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Ministry of Mines** has recently described several northeastern states as "quiet mineral frontiers" and "resource-rich frontiers", highlighting their potential for strategic minerals.  This language shift, which emphasizes the hidden wealth beneath the region's hills, suggests a broader change in how the northeast is portrayed in national conversations about resources and development opportunities.

top_stories.title: How A Bid To Help Iran Left Two Indian Brothers In Detention In Saudi Arabia
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Mohammad Rahib** and **Mohammad Zafar**, two Indian nationals from Uttar Pradesh, were detained by **Saudi** police in Dammam after sending money to the Iranian embassy's bank account.  Their family has not received any information about their whereabouts since March 30th. The brothers' father, Hassan Abbas, appealed to **External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar**, while the All India Shia Personal Law Board (AIMPLB) raised the issue with **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh**. The Indian Embassy in Riyadh is also investigating the situation and awaiting further information from the **Saudi Foreign Ministry**.
